title: Turtle dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- back leg left -->
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='78' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#4caf50'/>
    <!-- front leg right -->
    <ellipse cx='70' cy='78' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#4caf50'/>
    <!-- raised arm left -->
    <ellipse cx='18' cy='42' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(-30 18 42)' fill='#66bb6a'/>
    <!-- raised arm right -->
    <ellipse cx='82' cy='42' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(30 82 42)' fill='#66bb6a'/>
    <!-- shell -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#2e7d32'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#43a047'/>
    <!-- shell pattern -->
    <path d='M50 42 L58 52 L54 66 L46 66 L42 52 Z' fill='#81c784'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='4' fill='#a5d6a7'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#66bb6a'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='45' cy='28' r='3' fill='#0d2b18'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='28' r='3' fill='#0d2b18'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='27' r='1' fill='#d6ffdd'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='27' r='1' fill='#d6ffdd'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M44 34 Q50 39 56 34' stroke='#1b5e20' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- hat -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='14' ry='3' fill='#7e57c2'/>
    <rect x='43' y='8' width='14' height='12' rx='2' fill='#9575cd'/>
    <!-- musical notes -->
    <g fill='#ffd54f'>
      <circle cx='20' cy='22' r='3'/>
      <rect x='22' y='10' width='2' height='12'/>
      <circle cx='80' cy='18' r='3'/>
      <rect x='82' y='6' width='2' height='12'/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
